title: "📷 Light Preserver Archive"
subtitle: "DIGITAL & ANALOG PHOTOGRAPH GALLERY"
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<style>
  .gallery-layout-container {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }
  
  /* 좌측 격자형 사진 적재 영역 */
  .gallery-grid-zone {
    flex: 1;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 1.5rem;
    align-content: start;
  }
  
  /* 우측 미니멀 필터 타워 */
  .gallery-sidebar-zone {
    width: 180px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  /* 프리미엄 포토 카드 컴포넌트 */
  .gallery-photo-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.01);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
  }
  .gallery-photo-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  }
  
  .gallery-card-img-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    height: 180px; /* 시각적 몰입감을 위해 세로고를 미세하게 증설 */
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #f5f5f7;
  }
  .gallery-card-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  }
  .gallery-photo-card:hover .gallery-card-img {
    transform: scale(1.02);
  }
  
  .gallery-card-info {
    padding: 1rem;
  }
  .gallery-card-date {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: #86868b;
    margin-bottom: 0.15rem;
    font-family: "SF Pro Text", sans-serif;
  }
  .gallery-card-title {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin: 0 0 0.4rem 0;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .gallery-card-desc {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #424245;
    line-height: 1.4;
    margin: 0 0 0.6rem 0;
  }

  /* 하단 태그 미니멀 칩 스타일 */
  .gallery-card-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    border: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
    color: #86868b;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.4rem;
    margin-right: 0.3rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  
  /* 3축 필터 링크 디자인 */
  .gallery-filter-block {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed;
    padding-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .gallery-filter-block:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
  .gallery-filter-title {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .gallery-filter-link {
    display: block;
    color: #86868b;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    padding: 0.2rem 0;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .gallery-filter-link:hover, 
  .gallery-filter-link.active {
    color: #007aff;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .gallery-layout-container { flex-direction: column-reverse; gap: 1.5rem; }
    .gallery-grid-zone { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
    .gallery-sidebar-zone { width: 100%; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e8e8ed; padding-bottom: 1rem; }
    .gallery-filter-block { margin-bottom: 0; border-bottom: none; padding-bottom: 0; }
  }
</style>

<div class="gallery-layout-container">
  <div class="gallery-grid-zone" id="galleryGrid">
    <p style="color: #86868b;">JSON 데이터 허브 결합 중...</p>
  </div>
  
  <div class="gallery-sidebar-zone" id="gallerySidebar"></div>
</div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const gridZone = document.getElementById('galleryGrid');
    const sidebarZone = document.getElementById('gallerySidebar');
    
    const activeFilters = { period: 'all', theme: 'all', camera: 'all' };
    let globalPhotoData = [];

    // 🌟 Step 1: JSON 데이터 공급원 인입
    fetch('gallery.json')
      .then(res => {
        if(!res.ok) throw new Error("JSON 파이프라인 응답 실패");
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        globalPhotoData = data;
        buildEngine();
      })
      .catch(err => {
        gridZone.innerHTML = `<p style="color: #ff3b30;">자산 공급선 데이터 에러: ${err.message}</p>`;
      });

    function buildEngine() {
      const periods = new Set();
      const themes = new Set();
      const cameras = new Set();

      // 🌟 Step 2: 박사님의 고유 스키마(period, theme, camera) 직결 파싱
      globalPhotoData.forEach(item => {
        // "2021.05" 에서 필터링에 사용할 4자리 연도(Year) 추출
        const yearYear = item.period ? item.period.substring(0, 4) : "Unknown";
        const themeTheme = item.theme || "Unknown";
        const cameraCamera = item.camera || "Unknown";

        periods.add(yearYear);
        themes.add(themeTheme);
        cameras.add(cameraCamera);

        // 연산 전용 캐시 데이터 매핑
        item.computed = { period: yearYear, theme: themeTheme, camera: cameraCamera };
      });

      // 🌟 Step 3: 3축 필터 보드 구축
      renderFilterBlock('Period', periods, 'period');
      renderFilterBlock('Theme', themes, 'theme');
      renderFilterBlock('Camera', cameras, 'camera');

      // 초기 리스트 출하
      executeCrossFilter();
    }

    function renderFilterBlock(title, dataSet, filterKey) {
      const sorted = Array.from(dataSet).sort();
      if(filterKey === 'period') sorted.reverse();

      const block = document.createElement('div');
      block.className = 'gallery-filter-block';
      
      let html = `<div class="gallery-filter-title">${title}</div>`;
      html += `<a href="#" class="gallery-filter-link active" data-key="${filterKey}" data-val="all">All</a>`;
      sorted.forEach(val => {
        html += `<a href="#" class="gallery-filter-link" data-key="${filterKey}" data-val="${val}">${val}</a>`;
      });
      
      block.innerHTML = html;
      sidebarZone.appendChild(block);

      block.querySelectorAll('.gallery-filter-link').forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault();
          block.querySelectorAll('.gallery-filter-link').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('active'));
          this.classList.add('active');

          activeFilters[filterKey] = this.getAttribute('data-val');
          executeCrossFilter();
        });
      });
    }

    // 🌟 Step 4: 다차원 교집합(AND) 필터 연산 시스템
    function executeCrossFilter() {
      gridZone.innerHTML = '';
      
      const filteredData = globalPhotoData.filter(item => {
        const matchPeriod = (activeFilters.period === 'all') || (item.computed.period === activeFilters.period);
        const matchTheme = (activeFilters.theme === 'all') || (item.computed.theme === activeFilters.theme);
        const matchCamera = (activeFilters.camera === 'all') || (item.computed.camera === activeFilters.camera);
        return matchPeriod && matchTheme && matchCamera;
      });

      if(filteredData.length === 0) {
        gridZone.innerHTML = `<p style="grid-column: span 2; color: #86868b; text-align: center; padding: 4rem 0;">조건에 부합하는 사진 자산이 없습니다.</p>`;
        return;
      }

      // 🌟 Step 5: 실시간 최종 렌더링 카드 주입 (`desc` 및 `period` 바인딩)
      filteredData.forEach(item => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'gallery-photo-card';
        
        // 메타 칩 자동 동기화 생성
        const tags = [item.period, item.theme, item.camera].filter(Boolean);
        let tagsHtml = '';
        tags.forEach(t => { tagsHtml += `<span class="gallery-card-tag">${t}</span>`; });

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="gallery-card-img-wrapper">
            <img src="${item.image}" class="gallery-card-img" alt="${item.title}" loading="lazy">
          </div>
          <div class="gallery-card-info">
            <div class="gallery-card-date">${item.period}</div>
            <h3 class="gallery-card-title">${item.title}</h3>
            <p class="gallery-card-desc">${item.desc || ''}</p>
            <div class="gallery-card-tags">${tagsHtml}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        gridZone.appendChild(card);
      });
    }
  });
</script>
```
